name: veripay-ai
description: VeriPay AI - Delivery Verification & Milestone Payment Platform

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install --include=dev && npm --prefix client install --include=dev
scripts.install:all: npm install --include=dev && npm --prefix server install --include=dev && npm --prefix client install --include=dev
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:server: cd server && npx tsx watch src/index.ts
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build:client && cd server && npx tsc
scripts.sdk:generate: npx --yes @apimatic/cli sdk generate -i apimatic -l typescript -d apimatic/sdk/typescript -f -k "$APIMATIC_API_KEY"
